items.text: Treat these as outputs to reach, not a fixed calendar.
Small habits compound faster than bursts of effort.
Employers trust artefacts more than lists.
These are rated for how far your own effort can scale beyond a salary.
Paying clients are strong proof, and the venture can scale after graduation.
What earns trust Delivered work and reviews.
